description: Java class utility for managing SEO configuration based on an XML file (SeoConfig.xml), including pattern matching, URL rewriting, session ID handling, and URL filtering. Provides mechanisms to initialize and access SEO-related settings.

classes.name: SeoConfigUtil
classes.description: Final utility class for managing SEO configurations, reading from SeoConfig.xml, and providing access to SEO URL patterns, replacements, session ID handling, and URL filtering.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes SEO configuration by reading SeoConfig.xml, parsing patterns, and setting internal flags and collections.

methods.name: isInitialed
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration has been successfully initialized.

methods.name: checkUseUrlRegexp
methods.description: Indicates if URL regex patterns are enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getGeneralRegexpPattern
methods.description: Returns the general 'regexpifmatch' pattern used for matching URLs.

methods.name: checkCategoryUrl
methods.description: Indicates whether category URLs are enabled.

methods.name: isCategoryUrlEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific context path is enabled for category URL rewriting.

methods.name: isCategoryNameEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether category name in URL is enabled.

methods.name: getCategoryUrlSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix appended to category URLs.

methods.name: isJSessionIdAnonEnabled
methods.description: Checks if JSESSIONID is enabled for anonymous sessions.

methods.name: isJSessionIdUserEnabled
methods.description: Checks if JSESSIONID is enabled for logged-in users.

methods.name: getUserExceptionPatterns
methods.description: Returns list of regex patterns for URLs exempted from JSESSIONID handling.

methods.name: getCharFilters
methods.description: Returns character filtering patterns used in URL sanitization.

methods.name: getSeoPatterns
methods.description: Returns map of URL patterns to their regex Pattern objects for SEO rewriting.

methods.name: getSeoReplacements
methods.description: Returns map of URL patterns to their replacement strings for SEO URL rewriting.

methods.name: getForwardReplacements
methods.description: Returns map of URL patterns to forward replacements.

methods.name: getForwardResponseCodes
methods.description: Returns map of URL patterns to HTTP response codes for forwarded URLs.

methods.name: isSpecialProductId
methods.description: Deprecated: Checks if a product ID is considered special.

methods.name: addSpecialProductId
methods.description: Deprecated: Adds a product ID to the special products list.

methods.name: getSpecialProductId
methods.description: Deprecated: Retrieves original product ID from special list.

methods.name: getDefaultResponseCode
methods.description: Returns the default HTTP response code used for URL forwarding.
